div.p: Weights, times, and trends from your log

div.div: Set your profile to see stats

Strength scores compare your best top-set weight against published powerlifting norms (van den Hoek 2024, 809,986 entries), normalized by an effort factor for each lift relative to bench/squat anchors. Endurance and Speed scores use 1.5-mile and 1-mile run times against Cooper Institute / Texas DPS PRT standards, adjusted for your age and sex bracket.
Used for percentile calculations and to set your program start date.
